Author: ocealot
Name: AureliusJobBars
Description:
Additional job gauges, party buff timers, mitigation trackers, and more. Icon by PAPACHIN

Fork of 0ceal0t/JobBars: hover tooltips on the Buffs/Cooldowns icons (drawn in ImGui, since the overlay addon is click-through), and cooldowns hidden until the party member's level unlocks them.
Punchline: Extra job gauges, with native action tooltips on hover
Changelog: Tooltips are now drawn in ImGui - KamiToolKit's overlay addons are click-through by design, so native MouseOver never reaches these nodes. Bars stay click-through. Plus level-gated cooldowns.
